role: Route and conduct one bounded technical root-cause diagnosis.
notes: Pin candidate, worktree, environment, evidence and probe authority; use one discriminating loop; return an evidence-backed causal disposition. Diagnosis does not imply implementation authority.

children.note: Conditional regression seam only: TDD receives a settled deterministic behavior, independent oracle, matching candidate/worktree and explicit test/implementation authority, then returns here.

Performance receives one repeatable measurement loop and returns one experiment disposition. DevTools receives exact candidate/server/profile/fixture/interaction authority, gathers one read-only browser evidence packet, and returns without source edits. Playwright receives one exact candidate/worktree/server/fixture/interaction contract, authors, repairs, or runs one durable browser check, and returns its bounded verdict without silently fixing product source.
Dual Ship: independent multi-failure parallel agents

pipeline: test falsifiable hypotheses one variable at a time

forks.question: Which evidence loop best distinguishes this failure?
forks.recommended: Use the smallest repository-native focused test, command, request, or observation that reaches the reported symptom
branches: 1-parallel-agents when explicitly authorized for independent failures
0-implement when the cause and fix are already known and authorized
